summary: M10 Phase 1: Deep Writing Intelligence — autonomous multi-pass revision, style learning, cross-chapter consistency, and context-aware suggestions built on M9's agent/workflow infrastructure.
approach: Three parallel backend services (Wave 1) + unified frontend integration (Wave 2) + test coverage (Wave 3). Backend services are decoupled from UI state and communicate via MCP endpoints. Frontend connects through existing API client patterns. Each backend module includes its own MCP endpoint registration.

data_flow.diagram: RevisionOrchestrator <-> MCP / StyleProfile <-> MCP / ConsistencyContext <-> MCP -> Frontend API Client -> EvaluationPanel + AnalysisPanel + ChatArea
stages: Agent generates/revises text via existing /agent/write and /agent/revise
StyleProfile extracts patterns and injects into agent prompts
ConsistencyContext assembles cross-chapter knowledge for checking
Frontend panels consume new MCP endpoints via api/client.ts

design_decisions: RevisionOrchestrator is a standalone service, not a React hook — autonomous agent must work without UI
Style profiles stored per-project in projects/{id}/style-profiles/ alongside existing analysis cache
Consistency engine reuses existing runConsistencyCheck MCP endpoint, adds cross-chapter aggregation
All new MCP endpoints follow existing /agent/* and /analysis/* patterns
Frontend uses existing callApi() pattern from desktop/src/api/core.ts

patterns: callApi(endpoint, method, body) from desktop/src/api/core.ts for all HTTP calls
Service pattern: desktop/src/services/*.ts for business logic, hooks for UI binding
Analysis caching via content hashes in intelligenceService.ts
conventions: TypeScript strict mode, no any types
Existing i18n pattern: useI18n() hook with t.* keys
dependencies: desktop/src/api/client.ts — existing API client with processWritingHelper, runConsistencyCheck
